symbols.name: first space
symbols.meaning: A vector space, the first factor of the tensor product.
symbols.quote: Write $P$ and $Q$ for the two spaces, over the same ground field.

symbols.name: second space
symbols.meaning: A vector space, the second factor of the tensor product.
symbols.quote: Write $P$ and $Q$ for the two spaces, over the same ground field.

symbols.name: basis vector of P
symbols.meaning: A basis vector of the first factor P, paired with a basis vector f of Q to form a basis vector of the tensor product.
symbols.quote: The tensor product $P \otimes Q$ has as basis all pairs $e \otimes f$, where $e$ runs over a basis of $P$ and $f$ over a basis of $Q$.

symbols.name: basis vector of Q
symbols.meaning: A basis vector of the second factor Q, paired with a basis vector e of P to form a basis vector of the tensor product.
symbols.quote: The tensor product $P \otimes Q$ has as basis all pairs $e \otimes f$, where $e$ runs over a basis of $P$ and $f$ over a basis of $Q$.

relations.quote: Its defining property is that each [Bilinear form](bilinear-form.md) on $P$ and $Q$ becomes an ordinary linear map on $P \otimes Q$, so the tensor product linearizes it.
